svg.title: Trajectories: a family of panels. The main panel plots normalized Levin cost against scale, with a dotted fixed horizontal bound for the running maximum, dashed schematic fates, and the running maximum as the precise object; a side panel states the chain rule hinge as implications; a theorem panel keeps rKt and pKt apart as separate randomized measures; an evidence panel holds the finite checks off the axes
svg.desc: The precise object of the main panel is the running maximum of L(F) divided by log2(|F| + 2) over satisfiable formulas F of encoded length at most N, for the stated efficient interpreter: bounded if and only if P = NP, tending to infinity if and only if P != NP. A discovered program establishes an upper bound on L(F), not its exact minimum. The bounded and escaping curves are dashed because they are schematic possible behaviour, not measurements. Every curve label stands in the legend strip at the foot of the main panel, off the curves, keyed by a swatch of its own line.
svg.text: Trajectories: where the lines are heading
A family of panels: the cost axes, the hinge as implications, separate measures, the evidence
the precise object: the running maximum of the normalized
cost, defined in the text beside this chart

normalized Levin cost
dotted, white: a fixed bound for the running maximum,
A = a + max(c, 0), horizontal; conditional, not a result

K^t, Kt, pnKt, rKt, pKt: 5 measures,
named apart, never merged
Separate measures, their own panel
For rKt and for pKt, symmetry of information fails, proved as a theorem (Hu, Manor and Oliveira, ECCC TR26-021).
Those are separate randomized measures: their result stands here, in words, and draws no path on the cost axes.
Finite checks, off the axes
Worked example check: 800 fixed seed tree instances, 53,272 assignments scored against brute force.
Corpus counts: 651,086,719 inputs over 35,270 grow runs; bindings count: 31 targets, 18 bound.
They carry no coordinates on the cost axes: they can falsify a candidate, and they settle no bound.
Solid: measured or proved. Dashed: schematic possible behaviour. Dotted: conditional under a named premise.
No field equation governs these curves. The panels show where the lines are heading, never when an answer arrives.
The whole tree stands at 34,415,959 tokens at the count of 2026-11-23: the 38 million line approached, never crossed.
